records.literal_gloss: And these [are the] generations of Esau, that [is] Edom.

en.L: And these [are] the generations of Esau, that [is], Edom.
en.B: This is the account of the family of Esau, that is, Edom.
en.R: This is the list of Esau's family. Esau is also called Edom.

es.L: Y estas [son] las generaciones de Esaú, es decir, Edom.
es.B: Esta es la historia de la familia de Esaú, es decir, Edom.
es.R: Esta es la lista de la familia de Esaú. A Esaú también se le llama Edom.

fr.L: Et voici les générations d’Ésaü, c’est-à-dire d’Édom.
fr.B: Voici l’histoire de la famille d’Ésaü, c’est-à-dire d’Édom.
fr.R: Voici la liste de la famille d’Ésaü. Ésaü s’appelle aussi Édom.

sw.L: Na hivi [ndivyo] vizazi vya Esau, yaani, Edomu.
sw.B: Hii ndiyo habari ya jamaa ya Esau, yaani Edomu.
sw.R: Hii ndiyo orodha ya jamaa ya Esau. Esau anaitwa pia Edomu.

vi.L: Đây [là] dòng dõi của Ê-sau, tức là Ê-đôm.
vi.B: Đây là câu chuyện về dòng họ của Ê-sau, tức là Ê-đôm.
vi.R: Đây là danh sách dòng họ của Ê-sau. Ê-sau cũng được gọi là Ê-đôm.

ko.L: 에서, 곧 에돔의 계보는 이러하다.
ko.B: 에서, 곧 에돔의 집안 이야기는 이러하다.
ko.R: 에서의 집안 이야기는 이러하다. 에서는 에돔이라고도 부른다.

pt.L: E estas [são] as gerações de Esaú, isto [é], Edom.
pt.B: Este é o relato da família de Esaú, isto é, Edom.
pt.R: Esta é a lista da família de Esaú. Esaú também se chama Edom.

am.L: የዔሳው፣ ማለትም የኤዶም፣ ትውልድ ታሪክ ይህ ነው።
am.B: የዔሳው፣ ማለትም የኤዶም፣ ቤተሰብ ትውልድ ታሪክ ይህ ነው።

ja.L: そして、これはエサウ、すなわちエドムの系図である。
ja.B: エサウ、すなわちエドムの家系の記録は次のとおりである。
ja.R: これは、エサウの家族の記録です。エサウは、エドムとも呼ばれています。

decisions.choice: the generations of Esau: a new section of Genesis
decisions.reason: This heading (toledot) marks the sections of Genesis (2:4; 11:27; 25:12, 19; 37:2). As with Ishmael (25:12-18), the line not chosen is listed briefly before the story returns to the chosen line, Jacob's (37:2).

decisions.choice: Esau, that is, Edom: the name from the red stew
decisions.reason: Esau was called Edom ("red") after he sold his birthright for red stew (25:30). Edom became the people and land south-east of the Dead Sea, Israel's close kin and frequent enemy (Numbers 20:14-21; Obadiah).

decisions.choice: "dòng dõi của" (L), "câu chuyện về dòng họ của" (B), "danh sách dòng họ của" (R) for the toledot heading
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for the heading; Readable follows the English "list", since what follows here is a list of names.

decisions.choice: "~의 계보는 이러하다" (L); "~의 집안 이야기는 이러하다" (B, R) for toledot
decisions.reason: As the Genesis terms note sets for "these are the generations of": Literal keeps the old heading word, and Balanced and Readable say that a family's story begins here (meaning decision m1). Verse 9 follows it.

decisions.choice: "የ… ትውልድ ታሪክ ይህ ነው" for the toledot heading (L, B); "ይህ የ… ታሪክ ነው" (R)
decisions.reason: The heading opens a new section of Genesis, which tells what came of a man and his family, not only a list of descendants. "የትውልድ ታሪክ" (the story of the generations) says both, as in the Pentateuch terms, and is used for 36:9 and 37:2 too.

decisions.choice: "वंशावली" for toledot
decisions.reason: The word opens a new section of Genesis (m1): an account of a family line, which Hindi calls "वंशावली"; Balanced says "परिवार का वृत्तांत".

decisions.choice: родословие (L); история рода (B); список потомков (R)
decisions.reason: toledot opens a new section of Genesis (m1); each level says it in its own register, as the English does.

decisions.choice: toledot as "系図" (L); "家系の記録" (B); "家族の記録" (R)
decisions.reason: As at 25:12 and 25:19, where a list of descendants follows.

records.literal_gloss: Esau took his wives from [the] daughters of Canaan: Adah, daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah, daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,

en.L: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,
en.B: Esau married women of Canaan: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite,
en.R: Esau married women from Canaan. One was Adah, the daughter of Elon the Hittite. Another was Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah. Anah was the son of Zibeon the Hivite.

es.R: Esaú se casó con mujeres de Canaán. Una fue Ada, hija de Elón el hitita. Otra fue Oholibama, hija de Aná. Aná era hijo de Zibeón el heveo.

fr.L: Ésaü prit ses femmes parmi les filles de Canaan : Ada, fille d’Élon le Hittite, et Oholibama, fille d’Ana, fille de Tsibéon le Hévien,
fr.B: Ésaü épousa des femmes de Canaan : Ada, fille d’Élon le Hittite, Oholibama, fille d’Ana et petite-fille de Tsibéon le Hévien,

sw.L: Esau aliwatwaa wake zake kutoka kwa binti za Kanaani: Ada binti Eloni Mhiti, na Oholibama binti Ana, binti Sibeoni Mhivi,

sw.R: Esau alioa wanawake kutoka Kanaani. Mmoja alikuwa Ada, binti Eloni Mhiti. Mwingine alikuwa Oholibama, binti Ana. Ana alikuwa mwana wa Sibeoni Mhivi.

am.L: ዔሳው ሚስቶቹን ከከነዓን ሴቶች ልጆች ወሰደ፤ የኬጢያዊውን የኤሎንን ልጅ ዓዳን፣ የኤውያዊውም የጽብዖን ልጅ የዓናን ልጅ አህሊባማን፣

am.R: ዔሳው ከከነዓን ሴቶችን አገባ። አንዷ የኬጢያዊው የኤሎን ልጅ ዓዳ ነበረች። ሌላዋ የዓና ልጅ አህሊባማ ነበረች። ዓና የኤውያዊው የጽብዖን ልጅ ነበረ።

hi.L: एसाव ने कनान की बेटियों में से अपनी पत्नियाँ लीं: हित्ती एलोन की बेटी आदा, और अना की बेटी ओहोलीबामा, जो हिव्वी सिबोन की बेटी थी,

ru.L: Исав взял своих жён из дочерей Ханаана: Аду, дочь Елона хетта, и Оголиваму, дочь Аны, дочь Цивеона евея,
ru.B: Исав женился на хананеянках: на Аде, дочери хетта Елона, на Оголиваме, дочери Аны и внучке евея Цивеона,
ru.R: Исав женился на женщинах из Ханаана. Одна из них была Ада, дочь хетта Елона. Другая — Оголивама, дочь Аны. Ана был сыном евея Цивеона.

ja.L: エサウはカナンの娘たちの中から自分の妻たちをめとった。ヘト人エロンの娘アダと、アナの娘で、ヒビ人ツィブオンの娘であるオホリバマと、
ja.B: エサウはカナンの女たちを妻に迎えた。ヘト人エロンの娘アダ、アナの娘で、ヒビ人ツィブオンの孫娘にあたるオホリバマ、
ja.R: エサウはカナンの女の人たちと結婚しました。一人は、ヘト人エロンの娘アダでした。もう一人は、アナの娘オホリバマでした。アナは、ヒビ人ツィブオンの息子でした。

decisions.choice: Esau's wives: names that differ from the earlier lists
decisions.reason: Earlier Esau's wives are named as Judith daughter of Beeri and Basemath daughter of Elon, both Hittites (26:34), and Mahalath daughter of Ishmael (28:9). Here they are Adah daughter of Elon, Oholibamah, and Basemath daughter of Ishmael. Women could bear more than one name, or the lists may come from different sources; the text does not explain.

decisions.choice: daughter of Zibeon: Anah's father, so Oholibamah's grandfather
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "daughter of Zibeon", which can refer back to Oholibamah as a descendant. The Samaritan Pentateuch and the Greek translation read "son of Zibeon", agreeing with verse 24, where Anah is Zibeon's son. The sense is the same either way.

decisions.choice: the Hivite: one of the peoples of Canaan
decisions.reason: Zibeon is listed among the Horites of Seir in verse 20. Hivite and Horite may be related names, or the letters may have been confused in copying.

decisions.choice: granddaughter of Zibeon (B); Anah was the son of Zibeon (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the relationship as verse 24 gives it (m2).

decisions.choice: "Oholibama"
decisions.reason: The older Spanish form "Aholibama" comes through the Latin; "Oholibama" follows the Hebrew, as the other names in this chapter do. One form is used for every name throughout the chapter.

decisions.choice: passé simple at L and B ("prit", "épousa"), passé composé at R ("a épousé")
decisions.reason: French style guide, section 3: written narrative in the passé simple at Literal and Balanced, the spoken passé composé at Readable. The lists of names in this chapter use "voici" and the imperfect where French would.

decisions.choice: "Tsibéon"
decisions.reason: French spells the Hebrew ts sound "ts" in names (Tsibéon, Tsépho, Mibtsar), as French Bibles commonly do, and "sh" for the sh sound (Shobal, Dishon), as the terms list does with "Shéol". One form per name is kept through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "Sibeoni Mhivi"
decisions.reason: Swahili names end in a vowel (Eloni, Sibeoni, Elifazi), and a person's people is a class 1 noun after the name ("Mhiti", "Mhivi", "Mhori"). The ts sound of the Hebrew is written "s" (Sibeoni, Sefo). One form per name is kept through the chapter.

decisions.choice: Names in Esau's list follow the usual Protestant forms ("A-đa", "Ô-hô-li-ba-ma", "Bách-mát", "Ê-li-pha", "Rê-u-ên") and stay the same through the chapter
decisions.reason: The terms note asks that a name not in its table take the usual Protestant form and keep it through the book.

decisions.choice: "아나의 딸이요 히위 사람 시브온의 딸인 오홀리바마" (L); "손녀" (B)
decisions.reason: Read with verse 24, Zibeon is Anah's father, so Oholibamah is his granddaughter (meaning decision m2). Literal keeps the Hebrew's second "daughter", in the old sense of a female descendant, and attaches it to Oholibamah; Balanced says "손녀" and Readable makes Anah Zibeon's son, as the English does (verse 14 follows).

decisions.choice: Ada, Oolibama, Aná, Zibeão; and the other names of the chapter in their usual Brazilian forms
decisions.reason: For the whole chapter: the Edomite and Horite names take the forms Brazilian readers know from Portuguese Bibles, without the English spellings' h, th, ph and doubled letters: Elifaz, Reuel, Temã, Quenaz, Amaleque, Corá, Lotã, Sobal, Disom, Disã, Jobabe, Bozra, Hadade, Baal-Hanã, Meetabel. Basemate keeps the form of 26:34.

decisions.choice: the names of Esau's family and of Edom in their usual Ethiopian forms: ዓዳ, አህሊባማ, ዓና, ጽብዖን, ቤሴሞት, ኤልፋዝ, ቲምናዕ, ሴይር
alternatives: new spellings made from the Hebrew letters
decisions.reason: Amharic readers know these names in the forms Ethiopian Bibles have long used, and other chapters of Genesis and 1 Chronicles 1 repeat them, so the forms are kept the same through the book. The Hebrew ayin is written with ዐ/ዓ where that form is usual (ዓዳ, ዓና).

decisions.choice: traditional Russian forms of the names in this chapter (Ада, Оголивама, Цивеон, Елифаз, Рагуил, Иеус, Иеглом, Корей, хорреи and the rest)
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note asks for the established Russian Bible form of a name where one exists; Hittite is хетт, as the note gives the people.

decisions.choice: The verb "めとった" closes a first sentence, and the list of wives runs on with "と、" into 36:3
decisions.reason: Japanese puts the verb last; ending the verse on the list keeps each wife's name in her own verse.

decisions.choice: "オホリバマ" (Oholibamah), "ツィブオン" (Zibeon), "アナ" (Anah)
decisions.reason: Names not in the New Testament, transliterated from the Hebrew; the other names of chapter 36 follow the same pattern and are listed in the GEN-7 notes.

pt.R: Esaú também se casou com Basemate, filha de Ismael e irmã de Nebaiote.

am.L: የእስማኤልንም ልጅ፣ የነባዮትን እኅት ቤሴሞትን።
am.B: እንዲሁም የእስማኤል ልጅ፣ የነባዮት እኅት ቤሴሞት ነበሩ።
am.R: ዔሳው ደግሞ የእስማኤልን ልጅና የነባዮትን እኅት ቤሴሞትን አገባ።

hi.L: और इश्माएल की बेटी बासमत, जो नबायोत की बहन थी।
hi.B: और इश्माएल की बेटी और नबायोत की बहन बासमत से।
hi.R: एसाव ने बासमत से भी शादी की, जो इश्माएल की बेटी और नबायोत की बहन थी।

ru.L: и Васемафу, дочь Измаила, сестру Наваиофа.
ru.B: и на Васемафе, дочери Измаила, сестре Наваиофа.
ru.R: Ещё Исав женился на Васемафе, дочери Измаила и сестре Наваиофа.

ja.L: そして、イシュマエルの娘で、ネバヨトの妹であるバセマトである。
ja.B: そして、イシュマエルの娘で、ネバヨトの妹であるバセマトである。
ja.R: エサウは、イシュマエルの娘バセマトとも結婚しました。バセマトはネバヨトの妹でした。

decisions.choice: sister of Nebaioth: Ishmael's firstborn
decisions.reason: Nebaioth was Ishmael's eldest son (25:13). Esau's marriage into Ishmael's family is told in 28:9.

decisions.choice: "em gái" for Basemath as Nebaioth's sister
decisions.reason: Nebaioth was Ishmael's firstborn (25:13; meaning decision), so his sister was younger; Vietnamese must choose.

source.text: וַתֵּ֧לֶד עָדָ֛ה לְעֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת־אֱלִיפָ֑ז וּבָ֣שְׂמַ֔ת יָלְדָ֖ה אֶת־רְעוּאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And bore Adah to Esau Eliphaz, and Basemath bore Reuel.

en.L: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, and Basemath bore Reuel.
en.B: Adah bore Esau a son, Eliphaz, and Basemath bore Reuel.
en.R: Adah had a son named Eliphaz, and Basemath had a son named Reuel.

es.L: Y Ada dio a luz a Elifaz para Esaú, y Basemat dio a luz a Reuel.
es.B: Ada le dio a Esaú un hijo, Elifaz, y Basemat dio a luz a Reuel.
es.R: Ada tuvo un hijo llamado Elifaz, y Basemat tuvo un hijo llamado Reuel.

fr.L: Et Ada enfanta Éliphaz à Ésaü, et Basmath enfanta Réuel.
fr.B: Ada donna à Ésaü un fils, Éliphaz, et Basmath donna naissance à Réuel.
fr.R: Ada a eu un fils, qui s’appelait Éliphaz, et Basmath a eu un fils, qui s’appelait Réuel.

sw.L: Na Ada akamzalia Esau Elifazi, na Basemathi akamzaa Reueli.
sw.B: Ada alimzalia Esau mwana, Elifazi, naye Basemathi akamzaa Reueli.
sw.R: Ada alipata mtoto wa kiume aitwaye Elifazi, na Basemathi akapata mtoto wa kiume aitwaye Reueli.

vi.L: A-đa sinh Ê-li-pha cho Ê-sau, và Bách-mát sinh Rê-u-ên.
vi.B: A-đa sinh cho Ê-sau một con trai là Ê-li-pha, còn Bách-mát sinh Rê-u-ên.
vi.R: A-đa sinh một con trai tên là Ê-li-pha. Bách-mát sinh một con trai tên là Rê-u-ên.

ko.L: 아다는 에서에게 엘리바스를 낳았고, 바스맛은 르우엘을 낳았다.
ko.B: 아다는 에서에게 아들 엘리바스를 낳아 주었고, 바스맛은 르우엘을 낳았다.
ko.R: 아다는 엘리바스라는 아들을 낳았고, 바스맛은 르우엘이라는 아들을 낳았다.

pt.L: E Ada deu à luz Elifaz para Esaú, e Basemate deu à luz Reuel.
pt.B: Ada deu a Esaú um filho, Elifaz, e Basemate deu à luz Reuel.
pt.R: Ada teve um filho chamado Elifaz, e Basemate teve um filho chamado Reuel.

am.L: ዓዳም ለዔሳው ኤልፋዝን ወለደችለት፤ ቤሴሞትም ራጉኤልን ወለደች።
am.B: ዓዳ ለዔሳው ኤልፋዝ የተባለ ወንድ ልጅ ወለደችለት፤ ቤሴሞትም ራጉኤልን ወለደች።
am.R: ዓዳ ኤልፋዝ የተባለ ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች፤ ቤሴሞትም ራጉኤል የተባለ ወንድ ልጅ ወለደች።

hi.L: और आदा ने एसाव से एलीपज़ को जना, और बासमत ने रूएल को जना।
hi.B: आदा से एसाव का एक पुत्र एलीपज़ हुआ, और बासमत से रूएल।
hi.R: आदा का एक बेटा हुआ, जिसका नाम एलीपज़ था, और बासमत का एक बेटा हुआ, जिसका नाम रूएल था।

ru.L: И родила Ада Исаву Елифаза, а Васемафа родила Рагуила.
ru.B: Ада родила Исаву сына Елифаза, а Васемафа родила Рагуила.
ru.R: У Ады родился сын Елифаз, а у Васемафы — сын Рагуил.

ja.L: そしてアダはエサウにエリファズを産み、バセマトはレウエルを産んだ。
ja.B: アダはエサウとの間に息子エリファズを産み、バセマトはレウエルを産んだ。
ja.R: アダには、エリファズという息子が生まれました。バセマトには、レウエルという息子が生まれました。

decisions.choice: "ራጉኤል" for Reuel
decisions.reason: "ራጉኤል" is the form Ethiopian readers know for this name (also for Moses' father-in-law in Exodus 2:18), so it is kept here.

source.text: וְאָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ יָֽלְדָ֔ה אֶת־יְע֥וּשׁ וְאֶת־יַעְלָ֖ם וְאֶת־קֹ֑רַח אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלְּדוּ־ל֖וֹ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃

records.literal_gloss: And Oholibamah bore Jeush and Jalam and Korah. These [are the] sons of Esau who were born to him in [the] land of Canaan.

en.L: And Oholibamah bore Jeush and Jalam and Korah. These [are] the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
en.B: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were Esau's sons, born to him in the land of Canaan.
en.R: Oholibamah had three sons: Jeush, Jalam and Korah. All these sons of Esau were born in Canaan.

es.L: Y Oholibama dio a luz a Jeús, a Jalam y a Coré. Estos [son] los hijos de Esaú que le nacieron en la tierra de Canaán.
es.B: Oholibama dio a luz a Jeús, Jalam y Coré. Estos fueron los hijos de Esaú que le nacieron en la tierra de Canaán.
es.R: Oholibama tuvo tres hijos: Jeús, Jalam y Coré. Todos estos hijos de Esaú nacieron en Canaán.

fr.L: Et Oholibama enfanta Jéoush, Jalam et Coré. Ceux-là [sont] les fils d’Ésaü qui lui naquirent dans le pays de Canaan.
fr.B: Oholibama donna naissance à Jéoush, Jalam et Coré. Tels furent les fils d’Ésaü qui lui naquirent au pays de Canaan.
fr.R: Oholibama a eu trois fils : Jéoush, Jalam et Coré. Tous ces fils d’Ésaü sont nés au pays de Canaan.

sw.L: Na Oholibama akamzaa Yeushi na Yalamu na Kora. Hawa [ndio] wana wa Esau waliozaliwa kwake katika nchi ya Kanaani.
sw.B: Oholibama alimzaa Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora. Hao ndio wana wa Esau, waliozaliwa kwake katika nchi ya Kanaani.
sw.R: Oholibama alipata wana watatu: Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora. Wana hao wote wa Esau walizaliwa Kanaani.

vi.L: Ô-hô-li-ba-ma sinh Giê-úch, Gia-lam và Cô-ra. Đó [là] các con trai của Ê-sau đã sinh cho ông trong xứ Ca-na-an.
vi.B: Ô-hô-li-ba-ma sinh Giê-úch, Gia-lam và Cô-ra. Đó là các con trai của Ê-sau, sinh cho ông trong xứ Ca-na-an.
vi.R: Ô-hô-li-ba-ma sinh ba con trai là Giê-úch, Gia-lam và Cô-ra. Tất cả những con trai này của Ê-sau đều sinh ra ở Ca-na-an.

ko.L: 오홀리바마는 여우스와 얄람과 고라를 낳았다. 이들은 가나안 땅에서 에서에게 태어난 에서의 아들들이다.
ko.B: 오홀리바마는 여우스와 얄람과 고라를 낳았다. 이들이 가나안 땅에서 태어난 에서의 아들들이다.
ko.R: 오홀리바마는 아들 셋을 낳았는데, 여우스와 얄람과 고라였다. 에서의 이 아들들은 모두 가나안에서 태어났다.

pt.L: E Oolibama deu à luz Jeús, e Jalão, e Corá. Estes [são] os filhos de Esaú que lhe nasceram na terra de Canaã.
pt.B: Oolibama deu à luz Jeús, Jalão e Corá. Esses foram os filhos de Esaú, que lhe nasceram na terra de Canaã.
pt.R: Oolibama teve três filhos: Jeús, Jalão e Corá. Todos esses filhos de Esaú nasceram em Canaã.

am.L: አህሊባማም ይዑስን፣ ያዕላምንና ቆሬን ወለደች። እነዚህ በከነዓን ምድር የተወለዱለት የዔሳው ልጆች ናቸው።
am.B: አህሊባማ ይዑስን፣ ያዕላምንና ቆሬን ወለደች። እነዚህ በከነዓን ምድር የተወለዱለት የዔሳው ልጆች ነበሩ።
am.R: አህሊባማ ሦስት ወንዶች ልጆችን ወለደች፤ እነርሱም ይዑስ፣ ያዕላምና ቆሬ ናቸው። እነዚህ የዔሳው ልጆች ሁሉ የተወለዱት በከነዓን ነበር።

hi.L: और ओहोलीबामा ने यूश और यालाम और कोरह को जना। ये एसाव के पुत्र [हैं] जो कनान देश में उससे उत्पन्न हुए।
hi.B: ओहोलीबामा ने यूश, यालाम और कोरह को जन्म दिया। ये एसाव के पुत्र थे, जो कनान देश में उससे उत्पन्न हुए।
hi.R: ओहोलीबामा के तीन बेटे हुए: यूश, यालाम और कोरह। एसाव के ये सब बेटे कनान में पैदा हुए।

ru.L: А Оголивама родила Иеуса, и Иеглома, и Корея. Это сыновья Исава, которые родились у него в земле Ханаан.
ru.B: Оголивама родила Иеуса, Иеглома и Корея. Это сыновья Исава, родившиеся у него в земле Ханаан.
ru.R: У Оголивамы родились три сына: Иеус, Иеглом и Корей. Все эти сыновья Исава родились в Ханаане.

ja.L: そしてオホリバマはエウシュとヤラムとコラを産んだ。これらは、カナンの地で彼に生まれたエサウの息子たちである。
ja.B: オホリバマはエウシュ、ヤラム、コラを産んだ。以上が、カナンの地でエサウに生まれた息子たちである。
ja.R: オホリバマには、エウシュ、ヤラム、コラという三人の息子が生まれました。エサウのこの息子たちは、みなカナンで生まれました。

decisions.choice: Jeush, as the text is read
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew has Jeish; the Masoretes' marginal reading, followed here, is Jeush, the form found in verse 18 and 1 Chronicles 1:35. The same note applies in verse 14.

decisions.choice: "ይዑስ" for Jeush and "ያዕላም" for Jalam
decisions.reason: Spelled with an initial "የ", these names would read as "of Us", "of Elam", since "የ-" is the Amharic genitive prefix. The forms with "ይ" and "ያ" keep the Hebrew sound and read as names. "ይቴት" (Jetheth, 36:40) follows the same rule.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֣ח עֵשָׂ֡ו אֶת־נָ֠שָׁיו וְאֶת־בָּנָ֣יו וְאֶת־בְּנֹתָיו֮ וְאֶת־כָּל־נַפְשׁ֣וֹת בֵּיתוֹ֒ וְאֶת־מִקְנֵ֣הוּ וְאֶת־כָּל־בְּהֶמְתּ֗וֹ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־קִנְיָנ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָכַ֖שׁ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־אֶ֔רֶץ מִפְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֥ב אָחִֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Esau his wives and his sons and his daughters and all the persons of his house and his livestock and all his animals and all his property which he had acquired in [the] land of Canaan, and he went to a land away from Jacob his brother.

en.L: And Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters and all the people of his household, and his livestock and all his animals and all his property that he had acquired in the land of Canaan, and went to a land away from Jacob his brother.
en.B: Esau took his wives, his sons and daughters, everyone in his household, his herds and all his animals, and all the goods he had gained in Canaan, and went away to another land, apart from his brother Jacob.
en.R: Esau took his wives, his sons and daughters, and all the people who lived in his household. He also took his animals and everything he had gotten in Canaan. Then he moved away from his brother Jacob to another land.

es.L: Y tomó Esaú a sus mujeres, a sus hijos, a sus hijas y a todas las personas de su casa, y su ganado y todos sus animales y todos sus bienes que había adquirido en la tierra de Canaán, y se fue a una tierra lejos de Jacob su hermano.
es.B: Esaú tomó a sus mujeres, a sus hijos e hijas, a toda la gente de su casa, sus rebaños y todos sus animales, y todos los bienes que había reunido en Canaán, y se fue a otra tierra, lejos de su hermano Jacob.
es.R: Esaú tomó a sus mujeres, a sus hijos y a sus hijas, y a todas las personas que vivían en su casa. También se llevó sus animales y todo lo que había conseguido en Canaán. Luego se fue a vivir a otra tierra, lejos de su hermano Jacob.

fr.L: Et Ésaü prit ses femmes, et ses fils, et ses filles, et toutes les personnes de sa maison, et son bétail, et toutes ses bêtes, et tous ses biens qu’il avait acquis dans le pays de Canaan, et il s’en alla vers un pays loin de Jacob son frère.
fr.B: Ésaü prit ses femmes, ses fils et ses filles, tous les gens de sa maison, ses troupeaux et toutes ses bêtes, ainsi que tous les biens qu’il avait amassés en Canaan, et il partit pour un autre pays, à l’écart de son frère Jacob.
fr.R: Ésaü a pris ses femmes, ses fils et ses filles, et toutes les personnes qui vivaient chez lui. Il a pris aussi ses animaux et tout ce qu’il avait gagné en Canaan. Puis il est parti dans un autre pays, loin de son frère Jacob.

sw.L: Naye Esau akawatwaa wake zake, na wanawe, na binti zake, na watu wote wa nyumba yake, na mifugo yake, na wanyama wake wote, na mali yake yote aliyokuwa ameipata katika nchi ya Kanaani, akaenda nchi [nyingine] mbali na Yakobo ndugu yake.
sw.B: Esau aliwachukua wake zake, wanawe na binti zake, watu wote wa nyumba yake, makundi yake ya mifugo na wanyama wake wote, pamoja na mali yote aliyokuwa amejipatia huko Kanaani, akaenda nchi nyingine, mbali na ndugu yake Yakobo.
sw.R: Esau aliwachukua wake zake, wana wake na binti zake, na watu wote walioishi nyumbani mwake. Akachukua pia wanyama wake na kila kitu alichokuwa amepata huko Kanaani. Kisha akahamia nchi nyingine, mbali na ndugu yake Yakobo.

vi.L: Ê-sau đem các vợ, các con trai, các con gái, mọi người trong nhà mình, cùng súc vật, mọi thú vật và mọi tài sản mình đã gây dựng trong xứ Ca-na-an, đi đến một xứ cách xa Gia-cốp, em mình.
vi.B: Ê-sau đem các vợ, các con trai con gái, mọi người trong gia đình, đàn súc vật và mọi thú vật của mình, cùng mọi của cải đã gây dựng được ở Ca-na-an, đi sang một xứ khác, xa em mình là Gia-cốp.
vi.R: Ê-sau đem các vợ, các con trai con gái và mọi người sống trong gia đình mình. Ông cũng đem theo súc vật và mọi thứ ông có được ở Ca-na-an. Rồi ông dời đi một xứ khác, xa em mình là Gia-cốp.

ko.L: 에서는 그의 아내들과 그의 아들들과 그의 딸들과 그의 집의 모든 사람과, 그의 가축과 그의 모든 짐승과, 그가 가나안 땅에서 얻은 그의 모든 재산을 이끌고, 그의 동생 야곱을 떠나 [다른] 땅으로 갔다.
ko.B: 에서는 아내들과 아들딸들과 집안의 모든 사람, 가축과 모든 짐승, 그리고 가나안 땅에서 모은 모든 재산을 이끌고, 동생 야곱을 떠나 다른 땅으로 갔다.
ko.R: 에서는 자기 아내들과 아들딸들과 집안의 모든 사람을 데리고 갔다. 또 짐승들과 가나안에서 얻은 모든 것도 가지고 갔다. 그는 동생 야곱을 떠나 다른 땅으로 옮겨 갔다.

pt.L: E Esaú tomou as suas mulheres, e os seus filhos, e as suas filhas, e todas as pessoas da sua casa, e o seu gado, e todos os seus animais, e todos os seus bens que tinha adquirido na terra de Canaã, e foi para uma terra longe de Jacó, seu irmão.
pt.B: Esaú tomou as suas mulheres, os seus filhos e filhas, todas as pessoas da sua casa, os seus rebanhos e todos os seus animais, e todos os bens que tinha juntado em Canaã, e foi embora para outra terra, longe do seu irmão Jacó.
pt.R: Esaú levou as suas mulheres, os seus filhos e filhas e todas as pessoas que moravam na sua casa. Ele levou também os seus animais e tudo o que tinha conseguido em Canaã. Depois se mudou para outra terra, longe do seu irmão Jacó.

am.L: ዔሳውም ሚስቶቹን፣ ወንዶች ልጆቹንና ሴቶች ልጆቹን፣ የቤቱንም ሰዎች ሁሉ፣ ከብቶቹንም፣ እንስሶቹንም ሁሉ፣ በከነዓን ምድር ያፈራውንም ንብረት ሁሉ ወሰደ፤ ከወንድሙ ከያዕቆብም ርቆ ወደ [ሌላ] ምድር ሄደ።
am.B: ዔሳው ሚስቶቹን፣ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቹን፣ በቤቱ ያሉትን ሰዎች ሁሉ፣ መንጎቹንና እንስሶቹን ሁሉ፣ በከነዓንም ያገኘውን ሀብት ሁሉ ይዞ ከወንድሙ ከያዕቆብ ተለይቶ ወደ ሌላ ምድር ሄደ።
am.R: ዔሳው ሚስቶቹን፣ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቹን፣ በቤቱም የሚኖሩትን ሰዎች ሁሉ ወሰደ። እንስሶቹንና በከነዓን ያገኘውን ነገር ሁሉ ደግሞ ወሰደ። ከዚያም ከወንድሙ ከያዕቆብ ርቆ ወደ ሌላ ምድር ሄደ።

hi.L: और एसाव अपनी पत्नियों और अपने पुत्रों और अपनी बेटियों और अपने घर के सब प्राणियों को, और अपने पशुओं और अपने सब जानवरों और अपनी सारी संपत्ति को, जो उसने कनान देश में इकट्ठी की थी, लेकर अपने भाई याकूब से दूर किसी देश को चला गया।
hi.B: एसाव अपनी पत्नियों, अपने बेटे-बेटियों, अपने घर के सब लोगों, अपने गाय-बैलों और सब पशुओं, और कनान में कमाई अपनी सारी संपत्ति को लेकर अपने भाई याकूब से अलग किसी दूसरे देश में चला गया।
hi.R: एसाव ने अपनी पत्नियों, अपने बेटे-बेटियों और अपने घर में रहनेवाले सब लोगों को साथ लिया। उसने अपने पशु और कनान में कमाई हुई हर चीज़ भी साथ ली। फिर वह अपने भाई याकूब से दूर किसी दूसरे देश में चला गया।

ru.L: И взял Исав своих жён, и своих сыновей, и своих дочерей, и все души своего дома, и свой скот, и всех своих животных, и всё своё имущество, которое он приобрёл в земле Ханаан, и пошёл в землю прочь от Иакова, своего брата.
ru.B: Исав взял своих жён, сыновей и дочерей, всех домашних, свои стада, весь скот и всё добро, нажитое в Ханаане, и ушёл в другую землю, подальше от своего брата Иакова.
ru.R: Исав взял своих жён, сыновей и дочерей и всех людей, которые жили в его доме. Он взял также своих животных и всё, что нажил в Ханаане. Потом он ушёл от своего брата Иакова в другую землю.

ja.L: そしてエサウは、彼の妻たちと彼の息子たちと彼の娘たちと、彼の家のすべての者と、彼の家畜と彼のすべての動物と、彼がカナンの地で得たすべての財産を携えて、弟ヤコブから離れて、[ほかの]地へ行った。
ja.B: エサウは、妻たち、息子たちと娘たち、家のすべての者、家畜の群れとすべての動物、そしてカナンで手に入れたすべての財産を携えて、弟ヤコブから離れ、別の土地へ移って行った。
ja.R: エサウは、妻たちと息子たちと娘たち、そして家に住むすべての人を連れて行きました。動物も、カナンで手に入れた物も、すべて持って行きました。こうしてエサウは、弟のヤコブから離れて、別の土地に移りました。

decisions.choice: to a land away from Jacob: the land is not named
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "to a land". The Samaritan Pentateuch and some ancient translations add the name, "to the land of Seir", which verse 8 supplies.

source.text: כִּֽי־הָיָ֧ה רְכוּשָׁ֛ם רָ֖ב מִשֶּׁ֣בֶת יַחְדָּ֑ו וְלֹ֨א יָֽכְלָ֜ה אֶ֤רֶץ מְגֽוּרֵיהֶם֙ לָשֵׂ֣את אֹתָ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י מִקְנֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For was their property too much for dwelling together, and was not able [the] land of their sojournings to support them because of their livestock.

en.L: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their sojournings could not support them because of their livestock.
en.B: They had too much wealth to live side by side; the land where they were living as foreigners could not feed all their herds.
en.R: The two brothers had too many animals to live together. There was not enough grass in the land for all their animals.

es.L: Porque sus posesiones eran demasiado grandes para habitar juntos, y la tierra de sus peregrinaciones no podía sostenerlos a causa de su ganado.
es.B: Tenían demasiadas riquezas para vivir uno junto al otro; la tierra donde vivían como extranjeros no podía alimentar todos sus rebaños.
es.R: Los dos hermanos tenían demasiados animales para vivir juntos. En aquella tierra no había pasto suficiente para todos sus animales.

fr.L: Car leurs biens étaient trop nombreux pour habiter ensemble, et le pays de leurs séjours ne pouvait pas les porter à cause de leur bétail.
fr.B: Ils avaient trop de richesses pour vivre côte à côte ; le pays où ils séjournaient en étrangers ne pouvait pas nourrir tous leurs troupeaux.
fr.R: Les deux frères avaient trop d’animaux pour vivre ensemble. Dans ce pays, il n’y avait pas assez d’herbe pour toutes leurs bêtes.

sw.L: Kwa maana mali zao zilikuwa nyingi mno kwa kukaa pamoja, wala nchi ya ugeni wao haikuweza kuwachukua kwa sababu ya mifugo yao.
sw.B: Walikuwa na mali nyingi mno wasiweze kuishi pamoja; nchi waliyokaa kama wageni haikuweza kulisha mifugo yao yote.
sw.R: Ndugu hao wawili walikuwa na wanyama wengi mno, hawakuweza kuishi pamoja. Hapakuwa na majani ya kutosha katika nchi ile kwa wanyama wao wote.

vi.L: Vì tài sản của họ quá nhiều nên không thể ở chung với nhau, và đất họ kiều ngụ không thể nuôi nổi họ vì súc vật của họ.
vi.B: Của cải của họ quá nhiều nên không thể sống gần nhau; vùng đất nơi họ sống như khách lạ không đủ nuôi tất cả đàn súc vật của họ.
vi.R: Hai anh em có quá nhiều súc vật nên không thể sống chung. Trong xứ không đủ cỏ cho tất cả súc vật của họ.

ko.L: 그들의 재산이 너무 많아서 함께 살 수 없었고, 그들이 나그네로 사는 땅이 그들의 가축 때문에 그들을 감당할 수 없었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 두 사람은 재산이 너무 많아서 함께 살 수 없었다. 그들이 나그네로 살던 땅은 그 많은 가축을 다 먹일 수 없었다.
ko.R: 두 형제는 짐승이 너무 많아서 함께 살 수 없었다. 그 땅에는 그 많은 짐승이 다 먹을 만큼 풀이 넉넉하지 않았다.

pt.L: Pois os seus bens eram grandes demais para habitarem juntos, e a terra das suas peregrinações não podia sustentá-los por causa do seu gado.
pt.B: Eles tinham riquezas demais para viverem lado a lado; a terra onde moravam como estrangeiros não podia alimentar todos os seus rebanhos.
pt.R: Os dois irmãos tinham animais demais para morarem juntos. Não havia pasto suficiente na terra para todos os animais deles.

am.L: ሀብታቸው አብረው ለመኖር እጅግ ብዙ ነበረና፤ እንደ መጻተኛ የኖሩባትም ምድር ከከብቶቻቸው የተነሣ ልትሸከማቸው አልቻለችም።
am.B: አብረው ጎን ለጎን ለመኖር ሀብታቸው እጅግ በዝቶ ነበር፤ እንደ መጻተኛ የሚኖሩባትም ምድር መንጎቻቸውን ሁሉ ልትመግብ አልቻለችም።
am.R: ሁለቱ ወንድማማቾች አብረው ለመኖር እጅግ ብዙ እንስሳ ነበራቸው። በምድሪቱ ላይ ለእንስሶቻቸው ሁሉ የሚበቃ ሣር አልነበረም።

hi.L: क्योंकि उनकी संपत्ति इतनी अधिक थी कि वे एक साथ नहीं रह सकते थे, और उनके परदेशी होकर रहने का देश उनके पशुओं के कारण उनका भार नहीं उठा सकता था।
hi.B: उनके पास इतना धन था कि वे पास-पास नहीं रह सकते थे; जिस देश में वे परदेशी बनकर रहते थे, वह उनके सब पशुओं का पेट नहीं भर सकता था।
hi.R: दोनों भाइयों के पास इतने पशु थे कि वे साथ नहीं रह सकते थे। उस देश में उनके सब पशुओं के लिए काफ़ी घास नहीं थी।

ru.L: Ведь было их имущество слишком велико, чтобы жить вместе, и не могла земля их странствования прокормить их из-за их скота.
ru.B: У них было слишком много богатства, чтобы жить рядом; земля, где они жили как пришельцы, не могла прокормить всех их стад.
ru.R: У братьев было слишком много животных, чтобы жить вместе. В той земле не хватало травы для всех их животных.

ja.L: 彼らの財産が多すぎて、共に住むことができなかったからである。そして彼らの寄留の地は、彼らの家畜のために、彼らを養うことができなかった。
ja.B: 二人の財産はあまりに多く、一緒に住むことができなかった。彼らが寄留していた土地は、その家畜の群れをすべて養うことができなかったのである。
ja.R: 二人とも動物が多すぎて、一緒に住むことができなかったのです。その土地には、二人の動物全部に足りるだけの草がありませんでした。

decisions.choice: too great for them to dwell together: as with Abraham and Lot
decisions.reason: The words echo 13:6, when Abraham and Lot parted because the land could not hold both their flocks. Again the one not chosen leaves the land of promise.

source.text: וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב עֵשָׂו֙ בְּהַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: And dwelt Esau in [the] hill country of Seir; Esau, that [is] Edom.

en.L: So Esau dwelt in the hill country of Seir; Esau is Edom.
en.B: So Esau settled in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
en.R: So Esau went to live in the hills of Seir. Esau is also called Edom.

es.L: Así habitó Esaú en los montes de Seír; Esaú es Edom.
es.B: Así que Esaú se estableció en la región montañosa de Seír. Esaú es Edom.
es.R: Así que Esaú se fue a vivir a los montes de Seír. A Esaú también se le llama Edom.

fr.L: Et Ésaü habita dans la montagne de Séir ; Ésaü, c’est Édom.
fr.B: Ésaü s’établit donc dans la région montagneuse de Séir. Ésaü, c’est Édom.
fr.R: Ésaü est donc allé vivre dans les montagnes de Séir. Ésaü s’appelle aussi Édom.

sw.L: Basi Esau akakaa katika nchi ya milima ya Seiri; Esau ndiye Edomu.
sw.B: Hivyo Esau akaishi katika nchi ya milima ya Seiri. Esau ndiye Edomu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo Esau akaenda kuishi katika milima ya Seiri. Esau anaitwa pia Edomu.

vi.L: Vậy Ê-sau ở trên vùng núi Sê-i-rơ; Ê-sau là Ê-đôm.
vi.B: Vậy Ê-sau định cư trên vùng núi Sê-i-rơ. Ê-sau là Ê-đôm.
vi.R: Vậy Ê-sau đến sống trên vùng đồi núi Sê-i-rơ. Ê-sau cũng được gọi là Ê-đôm.

ko.L: 그래서 에서는 세일 산지에 살았다. 에서는 곧 에돔이다.
ko.B: 그래서 에서는 세일 산지에 자리를 잡았다. 에서가 곧 에돔이다.
ko.R: 그래서 에서는 세일 산지로 가서 살았다. 에서는 에돔이라고도 부른다.

pt.L: Assim Esaú habitou na região montanhosa de Seir; Esaú é Edom.
pt.B: Assim Esaú se estabeleceu na região montanhosa de Seir. Esaú é Edom.
pt.R: Então Esaú foi morar nas montanhas de Seir. Esaú também se chama Edom.

am.L: ዔሳውም በሴይር ተራራማ አገር ተቀመጠ፤ ዔሳው እርሱ ኤዶም ነው።
am.B: ስለዚህ ዔሳው በሴይር ተራራማ አገር መኖር ጀመረ። ዔሳው ኤዶም ነው።
am.R: ስለዚህ ዔሳው ሄዶ በሴይር ኮረብታዎች ኖረ። ዔሳው ኤዶም ተብሎም ይጠራል።

hi.L: इसलिए एसाव सेईर के पहाड़ी देश में बस गया; एसाव एदोम है।
hi.B: इसलिए एसाव सेईर के पहाड़ी प्रदेश में बस गया। एसाव ही एदोम है।
hi.R: इसलिए एसाव सेईर की पहाड़ियों में रहने चला गया। एसाव को एदोम भी कहते हैं।

ru.L: И поселился Исав в горах Сеира; Исав — это Едом.
ru.B: И Исав поселился в горах Сеира. Исав — это Едом.
ru.R: Так Исав ушёл жить в горы Сеира. Исава называют также Едомом.

ja.L: そしてエサウはセイルの山地に住んだ。エサウとはエドムである。
ja.B: こうしてエサウはセイルの山地に住みついた。エサウとはエドムのことである。
ja.R: こうしてエサウは、セイルの山地に移り住みました。エサウはエドムとも呼ばれています。

decisions.choice: the hill country of Seir: the mountains of Edom
decisions.reason: Seir is the range south-east of the Dead Sea. Esau was already in Seir when Jacob returned (32:3; 33:16); here his move is told in full.

source.text: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְד֥וֹת עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֣י אֱד֑וֹם בְּהַ֖ר שֵׂעִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And these [are the] generations of Esau, [the] father of Edom, in [the] hill country of Seir.

en.L: And these [are] the generations of Esau the father of Edom in the hill country of Seir.
en.B: This is the account of the family of Esau, ancestor of the Edomites, in the hill country of Seir.
en.R: This is the list of the families that came from Esau, the father of the Edomite people, in the hills of Seir.

es.L: Y estas [son] las generaciones de Esaú, padre de Edom, en los montes de Seír.
es.B: Esta es la historia de la familia de Esaú, antepasado de los edomitas, en la región montañosa de Seír.
es.R: Esta es la lista de las familias que vinieron de Esaú, el padre del pueblo edomita, en los montes de Seír.

fr.L: Et voici les générations d’Ésaü, père d’Édom, dans la montagne de Séir.
fr.B: Voici l’histoire de la famille d’Ésaü, ancêtre des Édomites, dans la région montagneuse de Séir.
fr.R: Voici la liste des familles qui sont venues d’Ésaü, le père du peuple d’Édom, dans les montagnes de Séir.

sw.L: Na hivi [ndivyo] vizazi vya Esau baba wa Edomu katika nchi ya milima ya Seiri.
sw.B: Hii ndiyo habari ya jamaa ya Esau, babu wa Waedomu, katika nchi ya milima ya Seiri.
sw.R: Hii ndiyo orodha ya jamaa zilizotoka kwa Esau, baba wa taifa la Waedomu, katika milima ya Seiri.

vi.L: Đây [là] dòng dõi của Ê-sau, tổ phụ của Ê-đôm, trên vùng núi Sê-i-rơ.
vi.B: Đây là câu chuyện về dòng họ của Ê-sau, tổ tiên của người Ê-đôm, trên vùng núi Sê-i-rơ.
vi.R: Đây là danh sách các gia đình ra từ Ê-sau, tổ tiên của dân Ê-đôm, trên vùng đồi núi Sê-i-rơ.

ko.L: 세일 산지에 사는 에돔의 조상 에서의 계보는 이러하다.

ja.L: そしてティムナはエサウの子エリファズの側女であって、エリファズにアマレクを産んだ。これらはエサウの妻アダの子らである。
ja.B: エサウの子エリファズの側女ティムナは、エリファズにアマレクを産んだ。以上が、エサウの妻アダの子孫である。
ja.R: エリファズには、ティムナというもう一人の妻もいました。ティムナには、アマレクという息子が生まれました。これが、エサウの妻アダの孫たちです。

decisions.choice: Amalek: ancestor of the Amalekites
decisions.reason: The Amalekites became Israel's bitter enemies, attacking them after the exodus (Exodus 17:8-16; Deuteronomy 25:17-19).

decisions.choice: the sons of Adah: her descendants, including grandsons
decisions.reason: "Sons" here includes Adah's grandsons through Eliphaz; Amalek, the son of a concubine, is counted with them.

decisions.choice: a lesser wife
decisions.reason: Readable explains the word "concubine" (see 35:22).

decisions.choice: "suria" (L, B); "mke mdogo" (R)
decisions.reason: "Suria" is the standard word for a concubine. At Readable, where the English explains the word as "a lesser wife", Swahili has its own everyday term, "mke mdogo", a junior wife of lower standing.

decisions.choice: "một người vợ thứ" (R) for the concubine
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the sense of a wife of lower rank in plain words, as the English "a lesser wife"; Literal and Balanced use "vợ lẽ", as in 35:22.

decisions.choice: "첩" at every level
decisions.reason: "첩" is the plain Korean word for a wife of lower rank and is still widely understood, so Readable keeps it where the English Readable says "a lesser wife".

decisions.choice: uma esposa de posição inferior
decisions.reason: Readable explains "concubina", as the English Readable says "a lesser wife" (r-en-1): a wife of lower rank. In 35:22 Readable could say "uma das mulheres do seu pai", because Bilhah is also called Jacob's wife; here the rank is the point of the note.

decisions.choice: "もう一人の妻" (R) for pilegesh; "側女" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that Timna was a wife of lower rank, as with Bilhah in 35:22.

records.literal_gloss: And these [are the] sons of Reuel: Nahath and Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were [the] sons of Basemath, [the] wife of Esau.

en.L: And these [are] the sons of Reuel: Nahath and Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.
en.B: The sons of Reuel were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Esau's wife Basemath.
en.R: Reuel's sons were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were the grandsons of Esau's wife Basemath.

es.L: Y estos [son] los hijos de Reuel: Nahat y Zera, Sama y Miza. Estos fueron los hijos de Basemat, mujer de Esaú.
es.B: Los hijos de Reuel fueron Nahat, Zera, Sama y Miza. Estos fueron los descendientes de Basemat, la mujer de Esaú.
es.R: Reuel tuvo cuatro hijos: Nahat, Zera, Sama y Miza. Ellos eran los nietos de Basemat, la esposa de Esaú.

fr.L: Et voici les fils de Réuel : Nahath et Zérah, Shamma et Mizza. Ce furent les fils de Basmath, femme d’Ésaü.
fr.B: Les fils de Réuel furent Nahath, Zérah, Shamma et Mizza. Tels furent les descendants de Basmath, femme d’Ésaü.
fr.R: Les fils de Réuel s’appelaient Nahath, Zérah, Shamma et Mizza. C’étaient les petits-fils de Basmath, la femme d’Ésaü.

sw.L: Na hawa [ndio] wana wa Reueli: Nahathi na Zera, Shama na Miza. Hawa walikuwa wana wa Basemathi mke wa Esau.
sw.B: Wana wa Reueli walikuwa Nahathi, Zera, Shama na Miza. Hao ndio wazao wa Basemathi mke wa Esau.
sw.R: Wana wa Reueli waliitwa Nahathi, Zera, Shama na Miza. Hao walikuwa wajukuu wa Basemathi, mke wa Esau.

vi.L: Đây [là] các con trai Rê-u-ên: Na-hát, Xê-rách, Sam-ma và Mích-xa. Đó là các con trai của Bách-mát, vợ Ê-sau.

vi.R: Các con trai của Rê-u-ên là Na-hát, Xê-rách, Sam-ma và Mích-xa. Đó là các cháu nội của Bách-mát, vợ Ê-sau.

ko.B: 르우엘의 아들들은 나핫, 세라, 삼마, 미사였다. 이들이 에서의 아내 바스맛의 자손이다.

ru.L: И вот сыновья Рагуила: Нахаф, и Зара, Шамма, и Мизза. Это были сыновья Васемафы, жены Исава.

ja.B: レウエルの息子は、ナハト、ゼラ、シャンマ、ミザである。以上が、エサウの妻バセマトの子孫である。

records.literal_gloss: And these were [the] sons of Oholibamah, daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon, wife of Esau: and she bore to Esau Jeush and Jalam and Korah.

en.L: And these were the sons of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: she bore to Esau Jeush and Jalam and Korah.
en.B: The sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah, daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon, were Jeush, Jalam and Korah, whom she bore to Esau.
en.R: Esau's wife Oholibamah was the daughter of Anah and the granddaughter of Zibeon. She had three sons with Esau: Jeush, Jalam and Korah.

es.L: Y estos fueron los hijos de Oholibama, hija de Aná, hija de Zibeón, mujer de Esaú: ella dio a luz para Esaú a Jeús, a Jalam y a Coré.
es.B: Los hijos de Oholibama, mujer de Esaú, hija de Aná y nieta de Zibeón, fueron Jeús, Jalam y Coré, que ella le dio a Esaú.
es.R: Oholibama, la esposa de Esaú, era hija de Aná y nieta de Zibeón. Ella tuvo tres hijos con Esaú: Jeús, Jalam y Coré.

fr.L: Et voici quels furent les fils d’Oholibama, fille d’Ana, fille de Tsibéon, femme d’Ésaü : elle enfanta à Ésaü Jéoush, Jalam et Coré.
fr.B: Les fils d’Oholibama, femme d’Ésaü, fille d’Ana et petite-fille de Tsibéon, furent Jéoush, Jalam et Coré, qu’elle donna à Ésaü.
fr.R: Oholibama, la femme d’Ésaü, était la fille d’Ana et la petite-fille de Tsibéon. Elle a eu trois fils avec Ésaü : Jéoush, Jalam et Coré.

sw.L: Na hawa walikuwa wana wa Oholibama binti Ana, binti Sibeoni, mke wa Esau: akamzalia Esau Yeushi na Yalamu na Kora.
sw.B: Wana wa Oholibama mke wa Esau, binti Ana na mjukuu wa Sibeoni, walikuwa Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora, ambao alimzalia Esau.
sw.R: Oholibama, mke wa Esau, alikuwa binti Ana na mjukuu wa Sibeoni. Alimzalia Esau wana watatu: Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora.

ko.R: 에서의 아내 오홀리바마는 아나의 딸이며 시브온의 손녀였다. 오홀리바마는 에서와의 사이에서 아들 셋을 낳았는데, 여우스와 얄람과 고라였다.

pt.R: Oolibama, mulher de Esaú, era filha de Aná e neta de Zibeão. Ela teve três filhos com Esaú: Jeús, Jalão e Corá.

ru.L: И вот были сыновья Оголивамы, дочери Аны, дочери Цивеона, жены Исава: и родила она Исаву Иеуса, и Иеглома, и Корея.

ru.R: Жена Исава Оголивама была дочерью Аны и внучкой Цивеона. У неё и Исава было три сына: Иеус, Иеглом и Корей.

ja.L: そしてこれらは、ツィブオンの娘アナの娘で、エサウの妻であるオホリバマの子らであった。彼女はエサウにエウシュとヤラムとコラを産んだ。
ja.B: アナの娘で、ツィブオンの孫娘にあたるエサウの妻オホリバマの息子は、エウシュ、ヤラム、コラである。彼女はこの三人をエサウに産んだ。
ja.R: エサウの妻オホリバマは、アナの娘で、ツィブオンの孫娘でした。オホリバマとエサウの間には、エウシュ、ヤラム、コラという三人の息子が生まれました。

decisions.choice: chiefs: leaders of clans
decisions.reason: 'Alluf is the title of the head of a clan; it may be related to 'elef, a clan or thousand. It is used for the rulers of Edom in Exodus 15:15. These chiefs ruled before Edom had kings (verse 31).

decisions.choice: leaders of the family groups
decisions.reason: Readable explains what the chiefs were.

decisions.choice: "jefe" ("el jefe Temán")
decisions.reason: The title of a clan head is rendered "jefe" throughout the chapter. Older Spanish versions say "duque" (from the Latin dux), which now suggests European nobility.

decisions.choice: "chef" ("le chef Téman")
decisions.reason: The title of a clan head is rendered "chef" throughout the chapter. "Duc", from the Latin dux of older versions, suggests European nobility. At Literal French needs the article before the title ("le chef Téman"), where the English says "chief Teman".

decisions.choice: "mkuu", plural "wakuu" (L, B); "viongozi" (R, as the English "leaders")
decisions.reason: "Mkuu" is the head of a clan or group and is used for the title throughout the chapter. "Chifu" is the modern loanword for an appointed local chief, and "jumbe" a village headman; both fit a later administration better than an ancient clan head.

decisions.choice: "trưởng tộc" (L, B) for the chiefs; "người đứng đầu các gia tộc" (R)
decisions.reason: The word names the leader of a clan (meaning decision); "trưởng tộc" says that, and Readable spells it out as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "족장" (L, B), "우두머리" (R) for the clan chiefs; Literal puts the title after each name ("데만 족장")
decisions.reason: The word means the leader of a clan (meaning decision m1). "족장" says that; "추장" suggests a tribal chief in a modern sense. Korean puts a title after a name, so Literal writes "데만 족장" for the Hebrew's "chief Teman"; Readable uses the everyday "우두머리". This holds through verse 43.

decisions.choice: o chefe (L); os chefes de clã (B); os líderes dos clãs (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole chapter: 'alluf is the head of a clan (m1). "Chefe" says that plainly; "príncipe" would make him royalty, and "duque", the old rendering, a European noble. Readable says "líderes dos clãs", the sense of the English "leaders of the family groups", with the shorter Portuguese word "clã".

decisions.choice: "አለቃ" (L, B) for the clan chief; "የቤተሰብ ጎሳዎች መሪዎች" (leaders of the family groups, R)
decisions.reason: The title names the head of a clan, not a royal rank. "አለቃ" is the plain Amharic word for a head or chief and goes before the name as the Hebrew title does ("አለቃ ቴማን"); "መስፍን" would suggest a nobleman. Readable follows the English "leaders of the family groups". This holds through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "सरदार" for alluf
decisions.reason: An alluf led a clan (m1); "सरदार" is the Hindi word for a clan chief, and Readable explains it as "कुलों के अगुवे".

decisions.reason: alluf is the leader of a clan (m1); «старейшина» is kept for the elders, and Readable explains the office, as the English does.

fr.R: Les fils de Réuel, le fils d’Ésaü, étaient les chefs Nahath, Zérah, Shamma et Mizza. Ces chefs du pays d’Édom venaient de Réuel. Ils descendaient de Basmath, la femme d’Ésaü.

sw.L: Na hawa [ndio] wana wa Reueli mwana wa Esau: mkuu Nahathi, mkuu Zera, mkuu Shama, mkuu Miza. Hawa [ndio] wakuu wa Reueli katika nchi ya Edomu; hawa [ndio] wana wa Basemathi mke wa Esau.
sw.B: Kutoka kwa wana wa Reueli mwana wa Esau walitoka wakuu Nahathi, Zera, Shama na Miza. Hao ndio wakuu waliotoka kwa Reueli katika nchi ya Edomu, wazao wa Basemathi mke wa Esau.
sw.R: Wana wa Reueli, mwana wa Esau, walikuwa viongozi Nahathi, Zera, Shama na Miza. Viongozi hao wa nchi ya Edomu walitoka kwa Reueli. Walikuwa wazao wa Basemathi, mke wa Esau.

vi.L: Đây [là] các con trai Rê-u-ên, con trai Ê-sau: trưởng tộc Na-hát, trưởng tộc Xê-rách, trưởng tộc Sam-ma, trưởng tộc Mích-xa. Đó [là] các trưởng tộc của Rê-u-ên trong xứ Ê-đôm; đó [là] các con trai của Bách-mát, vợ Ê-sau.
vi.B: Từ các con trai của Rê-u-ên, con trai Ê-sau, có các trưởng tộc Na-hát, Xê-rách, Sam-ma và Mích-xa. Đó là các trưởng tộc xuất thân từ Rê-u-ên trong xứ Ê-đôm, là con cháu của Bách-mát, vợ Ê-sau.
vi.R: Các con trai của Rê-u-ên, con trai Ê-sau, là những người đứng đầu tên Na-hát, Xê-rách, Sam-ma và Mích-xa. Những người đứng đầu này trong xứ Ê-đôm ra từ Rê-u-ên. Họ là con cháu của Bách-mát, vợ Ê-sau.

ko.L: 에서의 아들 르우엘의 아들들은 이러하다. 나핫 족장, 세라 족장, 삼마 족장, 미사 족장이다. 이들은 에돔 땅에 있는 르우엘의 족장들이며, 에서의 아내 바스맛의 아들들이다.
ko.B: 에서의 아들 르우엘의 아들들에게서 나핫, 세라, 삼마, 미사 족장이 나왔다. 이들은 에돔 땅에서 르우엘에게서 나온 족장들이며, 에서의 아내 바스맛의 자손이다.
ko.R: 에서의 아들 르우엘의 아들들은 우두머리 나핫, 세라, 삼마, 미사였다. 에돔 땅의 이 우두머리들은 르우엘에게서 나왔다. 그들은 에서의 아내 바스맛의 자손이었다.

pt.L: E estes [são] os filhos de Reuel, filho de Esaú: o chefe Naate, o chefe Zerá, o chefe Samá, o chefe Mizá. Estes [são] os chefes de Reuel na terra de Edom; estes [são] os filhos de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.
pt.B: Dos filhos de Reuel, filho de Esaú, vieram os chefes Naate, Zerá, Samá e Mizá. Esses foram os chefes descendentes de Reuel na terra de Edom, os descendentes de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.
pt.R: Os filhos de Reuel, filho de Esaú, foram os líderes Naate, Zerá, Samá e Mizá. Esses líderes na terra de Edom vieram de Reuel. Eram descendentes de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.

am.L: የዔሳው ልጅ የራጉኤል ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፦ አለቃ ናሖት፣ አለቃ ዛራ፣ አለቃ ሣማ፣ አለቃ ሚዛህ። በኤዶም ምድር የራጉኤል አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እነዚህ የዔሳው ሚስት የቤሴሞት ልጆች ናቸው።
am.B: ከዔሳው ልጅ ከራጉኤል ልጆች አለቆቹ ናሖት፣ ዛራ፣ ሣማና ሚዛህ ነበሩ። እነዚህ በኤዶም ምድር ከራጉኤል የተወለዱ አለቆች፣ የዔሳው ሚስት የቤሴሞት ዘሮች ነበሩ።
am.R: የዔሳው ልጅ የራጉኤል ልጆች መሪዎቹ ናሖት፣ ዛራ፣ ሣማና ሚዛህ ነበሩ። እነዚህ በኤዶም ምድር የነበሩ መሪዎች የመጡት ከራጉኤል ነበር። እነርሱ የዔሳው ሚስት የቤሴሞት ዘሮች ነበሩ።

hi.L: और एसाव के पुत्र रूएल के पुत्र ये [हैं]: सरदार नहत, सरदार जेरह, सरदार शम्मा, सरदार मिज्जा। एदोम देश में रूएल के सरदार ये [हैं]; ये एसाव की पत्नी बासमत के पुत्र [हैं]।
hi.B: एसाव के पुत्र रूएल के पुत्रों से ये सरदार निकले: नहत, जेरह, शम्मा और मिज्जा। एदोम देश में रूएल से निकले सरदार ये थे, जो एसाव की पत्नी बासमत के वंशज थे।
hi.R: एसाव के बेटे रूएल के बेटे ये अगुवे थे: नहत, जेरह, शम्मा और मिज्जा। एदोम देश के ये अगुवे रूएल से निकले थे। वे एसाव की पत्नी बासमत के वंशज थे।

ru.L: И вот сыновья Рагуила, сына Исава: вождь Нахаф, вождь Зара, вождь Шамма, вождь Мизза. Это вожди Рагуила в земле Едома; это сыновья Васемафы, жены Исава.
ru.B: От сыновей Рагуила, сына Исава, произошли вожди Нахаф, Зара, Шамма и Мизза. Это вожди, происшедшие от Рагуила в земле Едома, потомки жены Исава Васемафы.
ru.R: Сыновья Рагуила, сына Исава, были главами родов: Нахаф, Зара, Шамма и Мизза. Эти главы родов в земле Едома произошли от Рагуила. Они были потомками жены Исава Васемафы.

ja.L: そしてこれらはエサウの子レウエルの子らである。首長ナハト、首長ゼラ、首長シャンマ、首長ミザ。これらはエドムの地にいるレウエルの首長たちである。これらはエサウの妻バセマトの子らである。
ja.B: エサウの子レウエルの子孫からは、首長ナハト、ゼラ、シャンマ、ミザが出た。以上が、エドムの地でレウエルから出た首長たちで、エサウの妻バセマトの子孫である。
ja.R: エサウの息子レウエルの子孫からは、ナハト、ゼラ、シャンマ、ミザという指導者が出ました。エドムの地にいたこの指導者たちは、レウエルから出た人たちで、エサウの妻バセマトの子孫でした。

source.text: וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י אָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף יְע֛וּשׁ אַלּ֥וּף יַעְלָ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף קֹ֑רַח אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֞י אָֽהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה בַּת־עֲנָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

records.literal_gloss: And these [are the] sons of Oholibamah, wife of Esau: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These [are the] chiefs of Oholibamah, daughter of Anah, wife of Esau.

en.L: And these [are] the sons of Oholibamah, Esau's wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These [are] the chiefs born of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.
en.B: From the sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah came the chiefs Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the chiefs descended from Esau's wife Oholibamah, Anah's daughter.
en.R: The sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah were the leaders Jeush, Jalam and Korah. They were the leaders who came from Oholibamah, Anah's daughter.

es.L: Y estos [son] los hijos de Oholibama, mujer de Esaú: el jefe Jeús, el jefe Jalam, el jefe Coré. Estos [son] los jefes nacidos de Oholibama, hija de Aná, mujer de Esaú.
es.B: De los hijos de Oholibama, mujer de Esaú, salieron los jefes Jeús, Jalam y Coré. Estos fueron los jefes descendientes de Oholibama, hija de Aná y mujer de Esaú.
es.R: Los hijos de Oholibama, la esposa de Esaú, fueron los jefes Jeús, Jalam y Coré. Ellos fueron los jefes que vinieron de Oholibama, la hija de Aná.

fr.L: Et voici les fils d’Oholibama, femme d’Ésaü : le chef Jéoush, le chef Jalam, le chef Coré. Voici les chefs nés d’Oholibama, fille d’Ana, femme d’Ésaü.
fr.B: Des fils d’Oholibama, femme d’Ésaü, sortirent les chefs Jéoush, Jalam et Coré. Tels furent les chefs issus d’Oholibama, fille d’Ana, femme d’Ésaü.
fr.R: Les fils d’Oholibama, la femme d’Ésaü, étaient les chefs Jéoush, Jalam et Coré. C’étaient les chefs qui venaient d’Oholibama, la fille d’Ana.

sw.L: Na hawa [ndio] wana wa Oholibama mke wa Esau: mkuu Yeushi, mkuu Yalamu, mkuu Kora. Hawa [ndio] wakuu waliozaliwa na Oholibama binti Ana, mke wa Esau.
sw.B: Kutoka kwa wana wa Oholibama mke wa Esau walitoka wakuu Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora. Hao ndio wakuu waliotoka kwa Oholibama mke wa Esau, binti Ana.
sw.R: Wana wa Oholibama, mke wa Esau, walikuwa viongozi Yeushi, Yalamu na Kora. Hao ndio viongozi waliotoka kwa Oholibama, binti Ana.

vi.L: Đây [là] các con trai của Ô-hô-li-ba-ma, vợ Ê-sau: trưởng tộc Giê-úch, trưởng tộc Gia-lam, trưởng tộc Cô-ra. Đó [là] các trưởng tộc do Ô-hô-li-ba-ma, con gái A-na, vợ Ê-sau [sinh ra].
vi.B: Từ các con trai của Ô-hô-li-ba-ma, vợ Ê-sau, có các trưởng tộc Giê-úch, Gia-lam và Cô-ra. Đó là các trưởng tộc xuất thân từ Ô-hô-li-ba-ma, vợ Ê-sau, con gái của A-na.
vi.R: Các con trai của Ô-hô-li-ba-ma, vợ Ê-sau, là những người đứng đầu tên Giê-úch, Gia-lam và Cô-ra. Họ là những người đứng đầu ra từ Ô-hô-li-ba-ma, con gái của A-na.

ko.L: 에서의 아내 오홀리바마의 아들들은 이러하다. 여우스 족장, 얄람 족장, 고라 족장이다. 이들은 아나의 딸이며 에서의 아내인 오홀리바마에게서 [난] 족장들이다.
ko.B: 에서의 아내 오홀리바마의 아들들에게서 여우스, 얄람, 고라 족장이 나왔다. 이들은 아나의 딸이며 에서의 아내인 오홀리바마에게서 나온 족장들이다.
ko.R: 에서의 아내 오홀리바마의 아들들은 우두머리 여우스, 얄람, 고라였다. 그들은 아나의 딸 오홀리바마에게서 나온 우두머리들이었다.

pt.L: E estes [são] os filhos de Oolibama, mulher de Esaú: o chefe Jeús, o chefe Jalão, o chefe Corá. Estes [são] os chefes nascidos de Oolibama, filha de Aná, mulher de Esaú.
pt.B: Dos filhos de Oolibama, mulher de Esaú, vieram os chefes Jeús, Jalão e Corá. Esses foram os chefes descendentes de Oolibama, mulher de Esaú, filha de Aná.
pt.R: Os filhos de Oolibama, mulher de Esaú, foram os líderes Jeús, Jalão e Corá. Esses foram os líderes que vieram de Oolibama, filha de Aná.

am.L: የዔሳው ሚስት የአህሊባማ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፦ አለቃ ይዑስ፣ አለቃ ያዕላም፣ አለቃ ቆሬ። ከዔሳው ሚስት ከዓና ልጅ ከአህሊባማ [የተወለዱ] አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው።
am.B: ከዔሳው ሚስት ከአህሊባማ ልጆች አለቆቹ ይዑስ፣ ያዕላምና ቆሬ ነበሩ። እነዚህ ከዔሳው ሚስት ከዓና ልጅ ከአህሊባማ የተወለዱ አለቆች ነበሩ።
am.R: የዔሳው ሚስት የአህሊባማ ልጆች መሪዎቹ ይዑስ፣ ያዕላምና ቆሬ ነበሩ። እነዚህ ከዓና ልጅ ከአህሊባማ የመጡ መሪዎች ነበሩ።

hi.L: और एसाव की पत्नी ओहोलीबामा के पुत्र ये [हैं]: सरदार यूश, सरदार यालाम, सरदार कोरह। एसाव की पत्नी, अना की बेटी ओहोलीबामा से उत्पन्न सरदार ये [हैं]।
hi.B: एसाव की पत्नी ओहोलीबामा के पुत्रों से ये सरदार निकले: यूश, यालाम और कोरह। एसाव की पत्नी, अना की बेटी ओहोलीबामा से निकले सरदार ये थे।
hi.R: एसाव की पत्नी ओहोलीबामा के बेटे ये अगुवे थे: यूश, यालाम और कोरह। ये वे अगुवे थे जो अना की बेटी ओहोलीबामा से निकले थे।

ru.L: И вот сыновья Оголивамы, жены Исава: вождь Иеус, вождь Иеглом, вождь Корей. Это вожди Оголивамы, дочери Аны, жены Исава.
ru.B: От сыновей жены Исава Оголивамы произошли вожди Иеус, Иеглом и Корей. Это вожди, происшедшие от жены Исава Оголивамы, дочери Аны.
ru.R: Сыновья жены Исава Оголивамы были главами родов: Иеус, Иеглом и Корей. Это главы родов, которые произошли от Оголивамы, дочери Аны.

ja.L: そしてこれらはエサウの妻オホリバマの子らである。首長エウシュ、首長ヤラム、首長コラ。これらは、アナの娘で、エサウの妻であるオホリバマから出た首長たちである。
ja.B: エサウの妻オホリバマの子孫からは、首長エウシュ、ヤラム、コラが出た。以上が、アナの娘で、エサウの妻であるオホリバマから出た首長たちである。
ja.R: エサウの妻オホリバマの息子たちは、エウシュ、ヤラム、コラという指導者でした。この指導者たちは、アナの娘オホリバマから出た人たちでした。

source.text: אֵ֧לֶּה בְנֵי־עֵשָׂ֛ו וְאֵ֥לֶּה אַלּוּפֵיהֶ֖ם ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: These [are the] sons of Esau, and these their chiefs; that [is] Edom.

en.L: These [are] the sons of Esau, and these [are] their chiefs; that [is], Edom.
en.B: These are the sons of Esau, that is, Edom, and these are their chiefs.
en.R: These were the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and the leaders of their family groups.

es.L: Estos [son] los hijos de Esaú, y estos [son] sus jefes; es decir, Edom.
es.B: Estos son los hijos de Esaú, es decir, Edom, y estos son sus jefes.
es.R: Estos fueron los hijos de Esaú, que es Edom, y los jefes de sus familias.

fr.L: Voici les fils d’Ésaü, et voici leurs chefs ; c’est-à-dire Édom.
fr.B: Tels sont les fils d’Ésaü, c’est-à-dire d’Édom, et tels sont leurs chefs.
fr.R: Voilà les fils d’Ésaü, qu’on appelle aussi Édom, et les chefs de leurs familles.

sw.L: Hawa [ndio] wana wa Esau, na hawa [ndio] wakuu wao; yaani, Edomu.
sw.B: Hao ndio wana wa Esau, yaani Edomu, na hao ndio wakuu wao.
sw.R: Hao ndio wana wa Esau, aliyeitwa pia Edomu, na viongozi wa jamaa zao.

vi.L: Đó [là] các con trai Ê-sau, và đó [là] các trưởng tộc của họ; tức là Ê-đôm.
vi.B: Đó là các con trai của Ê-sau, tức là Ê-đôm, và đó là các trưởng tộc của họ.
vi.R: Đó là các con trai của Ê-sau, cũng gọi là Ê-đôm, và những người đứng đầu các gia tộc của họ.

ko.L: 이들은 에서의 아들들이며, 이들은 그들의 족장들이다. 그가 곧 에돔이다.
ko.B: 이들이 에서, 곧 에돔의 아들들이며, 이들이 그들의 족장들이다.
ko.R: 이들이 에서의 아들들과 그 집안들의 우두머리들이었다. 에서는 에돔이라고도 부른다.

pt.L: Estes [são] os filhos de Esaú, e estes [são] os seus chefes; isto [é], Edom.
pt.B: Esses são os filhos de Esaú, isto é, Edom, e esses são os seus chefes.
pt.R: Esses foram os filhos de Esaú, que é Edom, e os líderes dos seus clãs.

am.L: የዔሳው ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ አለቆቻቸውም እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እርሱም ኤዶም ነው።

decisions.choice: Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: the people before Edom
decisions.reason: The Horites lived in Seir before Esau's descendants. Deuteronomy 2:12, 22 says the sons of Esau drove them out and settled in their place. Esau's family married into theirs (verse 2). Seir is here the name of their ancestor as well as of the land.

decisions.choice: "người Hô-rít" for the Horites; the Horite names follow the usual Protestant forms
decisions.reason: Kept the same through the chapter ("Lô-than", "Sô-banh", "Đi-sôn", "Ét-xe", "Đi-san").

decisions.choice: "ሖሪያዊ" for a Horite, "ሖራውያን" for the Horites
decisions.reason: The people name is formed as the other peoples of Canaan are in the Pentateuch terms (ኬጢያውያን, ኤውያውያን). Hori the son of Lotan (36:22) keeps the bare name "ሖሪ".

decisions.choice: The list of Seir's sons runs on with "、" into 36:21
decisions.reason: As in 36:15-16, each name stays in its own verse and the sentence closes in the next one.

decisions.choice: the hot springs: an unknown word, probably springs of warm water
decisions.reason: Yemim occurs only here. The Latin translation took it as hot springs, and there are hot springs in the region east of the Dead Sea. Some ancient interpreters guessed "mules" (which fits the donkeys) or simply "water". A find worth remembering in a dry land.

decisions.choice: "suối nước nóng" for the hot springs
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word occurs only here and is uncertain; warm springs is the likely sense (meaning decision), as the English has it.

decisions.choice: as fontes termais (L, B); fontes de água quente (R)
decisions.reason: The word is uncertain (m1); Portuguese follows the reading the English takes. "Fontes termais" is the ordinary Brazilian term for hot springs; Readable says what they are in plain words.

decisions.choice: "ፍል ውኃ" (hot springs)
alternatives: a transliteration of the Hebrew word
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word occurs only here and is uncertain (see the meaning decision); "hot springs" is the likely sense, and "ፍል ውኃ" is the everyday Amharic word for a hot spring.

decisions.choice: "निर्जन प्रदेश" for the wilderness
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note settles "निर्जन प्रदेश"; Readable says "सुनसान इलाक़ा", as Matthew does.

decisions.choice: "温泉" (L, B); "温かい水がわき出る泉" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is otherwise unknown; the meaning decision reads it as hot springs, probably, and Japanese follows that reading.

ja.B: イスラエルの人々を王が治めるようになる前に、エドムの地を治めた王たちは次のとおりである。

decisions.choice: before any king reigned over Israel: Edom had kings first
decisions.reason: God had promised Jacob that kings would come from him (35:11), yet Esau's line has kings first, as Esau became great first. The line also shows that whoever gave the list its final form knew of Israel's kings; Saul was Israel's first.

decisions.choice: over the sons of Israel (L); over the people of Israel (B)
decisions.reason: Hebrew "a king of the sons of Israel" means a king of the Israelite people, so Literal and Balanced say "over".

decisions.choice: les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël (L); les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} (B)
decisions.reason: The settled French wording for "the sons of Israel" (Pentateuch terms list): "enfants" and "Israélites" include the whole people, with the traditional "fils" as the alternative. English "the sons of Israel" and "the people of Israel" carry no span here.

decisions.choice: {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}} at Literal, with no span in the English
decisions.reason: As in 32:33, the Pentateuch note gives Literal the inclusive "इस्राएल की सन्तान" with "इस्राएल के पुत्र" as the alternative; Balanced says "इस्राएली".

decisions.choice: {gender: детьми Израиля|сынами Израиля} (L); израильтяне (B)
decisions.reason: The forms the Pentateuch note settles for «the sons of Israel».

records.literal_gloss: And reigned in Edom Bela, [the] son of Beor, and [the] name of his city [was] Dinhabah.

en.L: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom, and the name of his city [was] Dinhabah.
en.B: Bela son of Beor was king in Edom; his city was named Dinhabah.

ko.R: 브올의 아들 벨라가 에돔의 왕이었다. 그의 성읍은 딘하바였다.

pt.L: E Belá, filho de Beor, reinou em Edom, e o nome da sua cidade [era] Dinabá.
pt.B: Belá, filho de Beor, foi rei em Edom; a sua cidade se chamava Dinabá.
pt.R: Belá, filho de Beor, foi rei de Edom. A cidade dele era Dinabá.

am.L: የቢዖርም ልጅ ቤላ በኤዶም ነገሠ፤ የከተማውም ስም ዲንሃባ [ነበረ]።

decisions.choice: Bela son of Beor: the kingship was not handed from father to son
decisions.reason: None of the eight kings in the list is the son of the king before him, and each comes from a different city. Edom's kings may have been chosen or may have won power, rather than inheriting it.

hi.L: और बेला मर गया, और बोस्रा के जेरह का पुत्र योबाब उसके स्थान पर राजा हुआ।

en.B: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites became king in his place.
en.R: When Jobab died, Husham became king. He came from the land of the Temanites.

es.R: Cuando Jobab murió, Husam llegó a ser rey. Era de la tierra de los temanitas.

fr.L: Et Jobab mourut, et Housham, du pays des Témanites, régna à sa place.

fr.R: Quand Jobab est mort, Housham est devenu roi. Il venait du pays des Témanites.

sw.R: Yobabu alipokufa, Hushamu akawa mfalme. Alitoka katika nchi ya Watemani.

vi.L: Giô-báp qua đời, và Hu-sam, người xứ Thê-man, trị vì thay cho vua.

vi.R: Khi Giô-báp qua đời, Hu-sam lên làm vua. Ông đến từ xứ của người Thê-man.

ko.L: 요밥이 죽고, 그 대신에 데만 사람의 땅 출신 후삼이 왕이 되었다.

ko.R: 요밥이 죽자, 후삼이 왕이 되었다. 후삼은 데만 사람의 땅에서 왔다.

pt.L: E Jobabe morreu, e Husão, da terra dos temanitas, reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Quando Jobabe morreu, Husão, da terra dos temanitas, foi rei em seu lugar.
pt.R: Quando Jobabe morreu, Husão se tornou rei. Ele era da terra dos temanitas.

am.L: ዮባብም ሞተ፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ ከቴማናውያን ምድር የሆነው ሑሳም ነገሠ።
am.B: ዮባብ በሞተ ጊዜ ከቴማናውያን ምድር የሆነው ሑሳም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
am.R: ዮባብ በሞተ ጊዜ ሑሳም ነገሠ። እርሱ ከቴማናውያን ምድር የመጣ ነበረ።

ru.B: Когда Иовав умер, вместо него царём стал Хушам из земли феманитян.
ru.R: Когда Иовав умер, царём стал Хушам. Он был из земли феманитян.

records.literal_gloss: And died Husham, and reigned in his place Hadad, [the] son of Bedad, who struck Midian in [the] field of Moab; and [the] name of his city [was] Avith.

en.L: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city [was] Avith.
en.B: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who beat the Midianites in battle in the land of Moab, became king in his place. His city was named Avith.
en.R: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad became king. He had defeated the Midianites in a battle in the land of Moab. His city was Avith.

es.L: Y murió Husam, y reinó en su lugar Hadad, hijo de Bedad, que derrotó a Madián en el campo de Moab; y el nombre de su ciudad [era] Avit.
es.B: Cuando murió Husam, Hadad, hijo de Bedad, que venció a los madianitas en el territorio de Moab, llegó a ser rey en su lugar. Su ciudad se llamaba Avit.
es.R: Cuando Husam murió, Hadad, hijo de Bedad, llegó a ser rey. Hadad había vencido a los madianitas en una batalla en la tierra de Moab. Su ciudad era Avit.

fr.L: Et Housham mourut, et Hadad, fils de Bedad, qui battit Madian dans la campagne de Moab, régna à sa place ; et le nom de sa ville [était] Avith.
fr.B: À la mort de Housham, Hadad, fils de Bedad, qui vainquit les Madianites dans le pays de Moab, devint roi à sa place. Sa ville s’appelait Avith.
fr.R: Quand Housham est mort, Hadad, fils de Bedad, est devenu roi. Il avait battu les Madianites dans une bataille au pays de Moab. Sa ville était Avith.

sw.L: Na Hushamu akafa, na Hadadi mwana wa Bedadi, aliyewapiga Midiani katika nchi ya Moabu, akatawala mahali pake; na jina la mji wake [lilikuwa] Avithi.
sw.B: Hushamu alipokufa, Hadadi mwana wa Bedadi, aliyewashinda Wamidiani vitani katika nchi ya Moabu, akawa mfalme mahali pake. Mji wake uliitwa Avithi.
sw.R: Hushamu alipokufa, Hadadi mwana wa Bedadi akawa mfalme. Hadadi alikuwa amewashinda Wamidiani katika vita huko nchi ya Moabu. Mji wake ulikuwa Avithi.

decisions.choice: Rehoboth on the River: a town by a river, which one is uncertain
decisions.reason: "The River" usually means the Euphrates (31:21), but that is far from Edom. Here it may be a local stream such as the brook Zered on Edom's border.

decisions.choice: "Saúl"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is the same as that of Israel's first king, and Spanish has only one form of it, "Saúl". English writes "Shaul" to keep the Edomite king apart from Saul; a Spanish "sh" would look foreign, so Spanish uses the ordinary form.

decisions.choice: "Shaoul"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is the same as that of Israel's first king, "Saül" in French. As the English writes "Shaul", French transcribes it "Shaoul" so that the Edomite king is not taken for Saul.

decisions.choice: "Shauli"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is the same as that of Israel's first king, "Sauli" in Swahili. As the English writes "Shaul", Swahili writes "Shauli" so that the Edomite king is not taken for Saul.

decisions.choice: "ሳኦል" for Shaul, king of Edom
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is the same as that of Israel's first king, whom Amharic readers know as "ሳኦል", so the same form is used; the context shows that this is a king of Edom.

decisions.choice: "महानद" for "the River"
decisions.reason: As in 31:21, Literal keeps "the River" as a title; which river is meant is uncertain here (m1), so Balanced and Readable say only "नदी".

decisions.choice: "川のほとりのレホボト", without naming the river
alternatives: "ユーフラテス川のほとりのレホボト"
decisions.reason: Which river is meant is uncertain (meaning decision m1), so Japanese does not say "ユーフラテス川" here.

records.literal_gloss: And died Baal-hanan, [the] son of Achbor, and reigned in his place Hadar, and [the] name of his city [was] Pau, and [the] name of his wife [was] Mehetabel, [the] daughter of Matred, [the] daughter of Mezahab.

en.L: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place; and the name of his city [was] Pau, and the name of his wife [was] Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
en.B: When Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, Hadar became king in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.
en.R: When Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, Hadar became king. His city was Pau. His wife was Mehetabel. She was the daughter of Matred and the granddaughter of Mezahab.

es.L: Y murió Baal-hanán, hijo de Acbor, y reinó en su lugar Hadar; y el nombre de su ciudad [era] Pau, y el nombre de su mujer [era] Mehetabel, hija de Matred, hija de Mezahab.
es.B: Cuando murió Baal-hanán, hijo de Acbor, Hadar llegó a ser rey en su lugar. Su ciudad se llamaba Pau, y su mujer era Mehetabel, hija de Matred y nieta de Mezahab.
es.R: Cuando Baal-hanán, hijo de Acbor, murió, Hadar llegó a ser rey. Su ciudad era Pau. Su esposa era Mehetabel. Ella era hija de Matred y nieta de Mezahab.

fr.L: Et Baal-Hanan, fils d’Akbor, mourut, et Hadar régna à sa place ; et le nom de sa ville [était] Paou, et le nom de sa femme [était] Mehétabel, fille de Matred, fille de Mézahab.
fr.B: À la mort de Baal-Hanan, fils d’Akbor, Hadar devint roi à sa place. Sa ville s’appelait Paou, et sa femme était Mehétabel, fille de Matred et petite-fille de Mézahab.
fr.R: Quand Baal-Hanan, fils d’Akbor, est mort, Hadar est devenu roi. Sa ville était Paou. Sa femme s’appelait Mehétabel. Elle était la fille de Matred et la petite-fille de Mézahab.

sw.L: Na Baal-hanani mwana wa Akbori akafa, na Hadari akatawala mahali pake; na jina la mji wake [lilikuwa] Pau, na jina la mkewe [lilikuwa] Mehetabeli binti Matredi, binti Mezahabu.
sw.B: Baal-hanani mwana wa Akbori alipokufa, Hadari akawa mfalme mahali pake. Mji wake uliitwa Pau, na mkewe alikuwa Mehetabeli binti Matredi, mjukuu wa Mezahabu.
sw.R: Baal-hanani mwana wa Akbori alipokufa, Hadari akawa mfalme. Mji wake ulikuwa Pau. Mke wake aliitwa Mehetabeli. Alikuwa binti Matredi na mjukuu wa Mezahabu.

vi.L: Ba-anh-Ha-nan, con trai Ạc-bồ, qua đời, và Ha-đa trị vì thay cho vua; tên thành của vua [là] Pha-u, và tên vợ vua [là] Mê-hê-ta-bê-ên, con gái Mát-rết, con gái Mê-xa-háp.

vi.R: Khi Ba-anh-Ha-nan con trai Ạc-bồ qua đời, Ha-đa lên làm vua. Thành của vua là Pha-u. Vợ vua là Mê-hê-ta-bê-ên. Bà là con gái của Mát-rết và cháu gái của Mê-xa-háp.

am.L: የዓክቦርም ልጅ በኣልሐናን ሞተ፤ በእርሱም ፋንታ ሃዳር ነገሠ፤ የከተማውም ስም ፋዑ [ነበረ]፤ የሚስቱም ስም የሜዛሃብ ልጅ የመጥሬድ ልጅ መሄጣብኤል [ነበረ]።

ru.L: И умер Баал-Ханан, сын Ахбора, и воцарился вместо него Хадар; и имя его города — Пау, а имя его жены — Мегетавеэль, дочь Матреды, дочь Ме-Загава.
ru.B: Когда Баал-Ханан, сын Ахбора, умер, вместо него царём стал Хадар. Его город назывался Пау, а жену его звали Мегетавеэль; она была дочерью Матреды и внучкой Ме-Загава.
ru.R: Когда Баал-Ханан, сын Ахбора, умер, царём стал Хадар. Его городом был Пау. Его жену звали Мегетавеэль. Она была дочерью Матреды и внучкой Ме-Загава.

ja.L: そしてアクボルの子バアル・ハナンが死に、ハダルが彼に代わって王となった。そして彼の町の名はパウであり、彼の妻の名は、メ・ザハブの娘マトレドの娘メヘタブエルであった。
ja.B: アクボルの子バアル・ハナンが死ぬと、ハダルが代わって王となった。その町の名はパウで、妻の名はメヘタブエルといった。彼女はマトレドの娘で、メ・ザハブの孫娘であった。
ja.R: アクボルの息子バアル・ハナンが死ぬと、ハダルが王になりました。ハダルの町はパウでした。ハダルの妻はメヘタブエルでした。メヘタブエルはマトレドの娘で、メ・ザハブの孫娘でした。

decisions.choice: Hadar, as in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: 1 Chronicles 1:50, the Samaritan Pentateuch and many Hebrew manuscripts read Hadad. In Hebrew the letters for d and r are very alike. The Hebrew text is followed here.

decisions.choice: Mehetabel, the last king's wife: the only woman named among the kings
decisions.reason: The list stops with Hadar and names his wife, perhaps because he was still reigning when the list was drawn up. Mezahab ("waters of gold") may be a person or a place.

decisions.choice: granddaughter of Mezahab
decisions.reason: "Daughter" here means descendant; Balanced and Readable say granddaughter, as in verse 2.

decisions.choice: "पोती" (a son's daughter) for Mezahab's "daughter"
decisions.reason: Hindi has two words for a granddaughter; the Hebrew does not say whether Matred was Mezahab's son or daughter, so Hindi takes the more usual line through a son, as in verse 2.

records.literal_gloss: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These [are the] chiefs of Edom by their dwellings in [the] land of their possession. He [is] Esau, [the] father of Edom.

en.L: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These [are] the chiefs of Edom, according to their dwelling places in the land they possessed. This [is] Esau, the father of Edom.
en.B: Magdiel and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, by their settlements in the land they held. This was Esau, ancestor of the Edomites.
en.R: Magdiel and Iram. These were the leaders of Edom, listed by the places where they lived in the land that belonged to them. All of them came from Esau, the father of the Edomite people.

es.L: el jefe Magdiel, el jefe Iram. Estos [son] los jefes de Edom, según sus moradas en la tierra que poseían. Este [es] Esaú, padre de Edom.
es.B: Magdiel e Iram. Estos fueron los jefes de Edom, según sus asentamientos en la tierra que tenían. Este fue Esaú, antepasado de los edomitas.
es.R: Magdiel e Iram. Estos fueron los jefes de Edom, ordenados según los lugares donde vivían en la tierra que era suya. Todos ellos vinieron de Esaú, el padre del pueblo edomita.

fr.L: le chef Magdiel, le chef Iram. Voici les chefs d’Édom, selon leurs demeures dans le pays qu’ils possédaient. C’est là Ésaü, père d’Édom.
fr.B: Magdiel et Iram. Tels furent les chefs d’Édom, selon leurs lieux d’établissement dans le pays qu’ils possédaient. C’est là Ésaü, l’ancêtre des Édomites.
fr.R: Magdiel et Iram. C’étaient les chefs d’Édom, classés selon les lieux où ils habitaient dans le pays qui leur appartenait. Ils venaient tous d’Ésaü, le père du peuple d’Édom.

sw.L: mkuu Magdieli, mkuu Iramu. Hawa [ndio] wakuu wa Edomu, kwa makao yao katika nchi ya milki yao. Huyu [ndiye] Esau, baba wa Edomu.
sw.B: Magdieli na Iramu. Hao ndio wakuu wa Edomu, kwa makao yao katika nchi waliyoimiliki. Huyo ndiye Esau, babu wa Waedomu.
sw.R: Magdieli na Iramu. Hao ndio viongozi wa Edomu, wameorodheshwa kwa mahali walipoishi katika nchi iliyokuwa mali yao. Wote walitoka kwa Esau, baba wa taifa la Waedomu.

vi.L: trưởng tộc Mác-đi-ên, trưởng tộc I-ram. Đó [là] các trưởng tộc của Ê-đôm, theo nơi cư trú của họ trong xứ họ chiếm hữu. Đó [là] Ê-sau, tổ phụ của Ê-đôm.

vi.R: Mác-đi-ên và I-ram. Đó là những người đứng đầu xứ Ê-đôm, kể theo nơi họ sống trong xứ thuộc về họ. Tất cả đều ra từ Ê-sau, tổ tiên của dân Ê-đôm.

ko.L: 막디엘 족장, 이람 족장이다. 이들은 그들이 차지한 땅에서 그들의 거주지대로 [본] 에돔의 족장들이다. 그가 곧 에돔의 조상 에서이다.

pt.L: o chefe Magdiel, o chefe Irã. Estes [são] os chefes de Edom, segundo as suas habitações na terra que possuíam. Este [é] Esaú, o pai de Edom.

hi.L: सरदार मग्दीएल, सरदार ईराम। एदोम के सरदार, अपने अधिकार के देश में अपनी बस्तियों के अनुसार, ये [हैं]। यही एदोम का पिता एसाव [है]।

ru.L: вождь Магдиил, вождь Ирам. Это вожди Едома по их поселениям в земле их владения. Это Исав, отец Едома.
ru.B: Магдиил и Ирам. Это вожди Едома по их поселениям в земле, которой они владели. Таков Исав, родоначальник едомитян.
ru.R: Магдиил и Ирам. Это главы родов Едома, названные по местам, где они жили в своей земле. Все они произошли от Исава, отца народа Едома.

ja.L: 首長マグディエル、首長イラム。これらは、彼らが所有する地におけるその住まいによる、エドムの首長たちである。これがエドムの父エサウである。
ja.B: マグディエル、イラムである。以上が、自分たちのものとなった土地での居住地ごとに挙げた、エドムの首長たちである。これが、エドム人の先祖エサウである。
ja.R: マグディエル、イラムです。これが、自分たちのものとなった土地で住んでいた場所ごとに挙げた、エドムの一族の指導者たちです。みな、エドム人の先祖であるエサウから出た人たちです。

decisions.choice: the land of their possession: Edom has its land
decisions.reason: Esau's descendants already hold a land of their own, while Jacob's family still lives in Canaan as foreigners (37:1). Later God tells Israel not to take Edom's land, for he gave Seir to Esau (Deuteronomy 2:5).
